findings.description: __aexit__ discards the actual exception arguments and calls self.__exit__(None, None, None), so the AttemptManager never sees the exception raised inside the async with block.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an exception is raised inside an `async with AttemptManager(...)` block. The sync __exit__ uses exc_type/exc_value to call set_exception and record the failure for retry; passing None makes __exit__ treat the attempt as successful, so set_result(None) is recorded and the retry loop never retries. Impact: failed attempts are silently reported as successful and the exception is swallowed or handled incorrectly, producing wrong results.
